engine: per-section COLOR engine — EVER slate->brown->green identity; chrome (bg/ink/accent/header) recolors as each section enters, tweened across the seam; modals inherit the active theme via the same CSS vars.

measured_live.EVER: per-section palette swap (slate ARCHITECTURE / brown INTERIOR / green TERRITORY); global header tints to the incoming theme ACROSS the seam (a tween, not a hard flip); modals (gallery, info-drawer, quote) inherit the active section's theme.

mechanism: CSS custom properties on a root scope (--bg/--ink/--accent...). An IntersectionObserver picks the centred section (ratio>0.5); the engine lerps the root vars from the current color toward that section's, in LINEAR-RGB (gamma 2.2), every rAF -> smooth recolor across the boundary. Anything reading var(--*) (page, header, a modal) recolors for free.

root.what: where the themed CSS vars live.

ease.what: rAF lerp factor toward the active theme (buttery, frame-rate-safe).

per_section_attrs: data-theme + data-theme-<var>=#hex for each var (e.g. data-theme-bg='#313E48' data-theme-ink='#DCC5B7' data-theme-accent='#AC7E65').
entry: ThemeTween.init(opts) -> { activeIndex, destroy }. Pair with bleeding-wordmark (the visible half of section identity) + section-pager (sync the tween to the curtain).
law: tweens COLOR custom-properties ONLY (no layout, no transform); linear-RGB interpolation for perceptual smoothness; reduced-motion -> snap to the active theme (no tween); works WITHOUT GSAP (own rAF lerp). NO WebGL.
proven: lab: OUR day-arc themes (РАНОК warm / ДЕНЬ slate / ВЕЧІР amber / НІЧ blue-black). Tween proven: section1->2 bg start rgb(42,33,26) -> MID rgb(46,52,58) -> settled rgb(49,62,72) (mid is between = a tween, not a snap). Header + a 'modal' chip recolor via the same vars = inherit the active theme. window.__LAB_OK__ set.
